The '''ZH-40 ''Tribune''-class light freighter''' was a model of [[light freighter]] produced by [[Starfeld Industries]], and a newer model of the [[ZH-25 Questor-class|ZH-25 ''Questor''-class]]. During the [[Imperial Era]], these freighters were used by the crime syndicates [[Crimson Dawn]] and [[Zerek Besh]].<ref name="Outlaws" /> The [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]] owned a modified ZH-40, the [[Katooni (ship)|''Katooni'']], at [[Black Spire Outpost]] on [[Batuu]].<ref name="Databank" /> At least one ZH-40 was part of the [[Citizens' Fleet]] that fought at the [[Battle of Exegol]] in [[35 ABY]].<ref name="Episode IX" />
